sloka: लक्ष्मणश्चापि धर्मात्मा मन्निदेशे व्यवस्थित: ।त्वं चानुकूला वैदेहि प्रीतिं जनयथो मम ॥ २.९५.१६॥
transliteration: lakṣmaṇaścāpi dharmātmā mannideśe vyavasthita: ।tvaṁ cānukūlā vaidehi prītiṁ janayatho mama ॥ 2.95.16॥

translations.english: With righteous Lakshmana obedient and you, O Sita, agreeable to me, you both bring me great pleasure.
